name: Magazine / News
description: An editorial homepage for a news or review site: a featured story grid with cover art, latest articles, category blocks, a trending list, newsletter, and a closing CTA. Populates the Magazine preset with realistic bilingual sample content about TNCMS and publishing.

rollback.notes: Restores the previous theme settings and homepage layout from the import snapshot. Imported demo media rows are reused on re-import.

warnings: Importing replaces the active homepage layout.
Importing updates the Magazine demo theme settings and imports its demo media.
Importing creates Magazine header and footer menus; resetting removes them.
